disease_mutation_row_level.name: disease_mutation_row_level
disease_mutation_row_level.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  chromosome_id,
  chromosome_pos,
  ref_nt,
  alt_nt,
  ensembl_transcript_id,
  cds_pos,
  peptide_pos,
  aa_pos_uniprotkb,
  ref_aa,
  alt_aa,
  mutation_freq,
  data_source,
  doid
FROM disease_mutation
disease_mutation_row_level.description: Row-level view of disease_mutation records exposing all native columns for filtering and selection. One row per disease_mutation entry.
validated_on: Show me all information about disease mutations with amino acid residue (ref_aa) equal to E
counter_examples: Show disease mutation chromosome positions for skin cancer

disease_mutation_with_transcript_mapping.name: disease_mutation_with_transcript_mapping
disease_mutation_with_transcript_mapping.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.id,
  dm.chromosome_id,
  dm.chromosome_pos,
  dm.ref_nt,
  dm.alt_nt,
  -- prefer the transcript id from disease_mutation if present, else fall back to mapped ensembl_transcript_id
  COALESCE(dm.ensembl_transcript_id, mpd.ensembl_transcript_id) AS ensembl_transcript_id,
  -- prefer uniprot mapping from map_protein_disease_mutation; if that table lacks canonical mapping, keep uniprotkb_ac as provided (nullable)
  mpd.uniprotkb_ac,
  dm.cds_pos,
  dm.peptide_pos,
  dm.aa_pos_uniprotkb,
  dm.ref_aa,
  dm.alt_aa,
  dm.mutation_freq,
  dm.data_source,
  dm.doid
FROM
  disease_mutation dm
  LEFT JOIN map_protein_disease_mutation mpd
    ON (dm.ensembl_transcript_id IS NOT NULL AND dm.ensembl_transcript_id = mpd.ensembl_transcript_id)
disease_mutation_with_transcript_mapping.description: Denormalized disease mutation rows joined to transcript/protein mapping (if available) to provide uniprot and ensembl mapping columns for downstream filters or display.

disease_mutation_source_cohort_by_amino_.name: disease_mutation_source_cohort_by_amino_acid
disease_mutation_source_cohort_by_amino_.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.ref_aa AS ref_aa,
  dm.data_source AS data_source,
  count(*)::bigint AS mutation_count,
  count(DISTINCT dm.id)::bigint AS distinct_mutation_ids_sample
FROM
  disease_mutation AS dm
GROUP BY
  dm.ref_aa,
  dm.data_source
disease_mutation_source_cohort_by_amino_.description: Aggregate counts of disease_mutation rows by reference amino-acid (ref_aa) and data_source to support summary/filters (keeps raw counts, no pre-filtering by specific letter). Grain is ref_aa + data_source.

fda_tests_row_level.name: fda_tests_row_level
fda_tests_row_level.body_sql:
SELECT
  test_trade_name,
  test_manufacturer,
  test_submission,
  biomarker_origin,
  test_approval_status,
  test_number_genes
FROM biomarker_fda_test
fda_tests_row_level.description: Row-level cohort of FDA test records from biomarker_fda_test. Each row is one FDA test record exposing identifying and filterable columns for downstream counting, filtering and grouping.

fda_test_manufacturer_summary.name: fda_test_manufacturer_summary
fda_test_manufacturer_summary.body_sql:
SELECT
  test_manufacturer,
  count(DISTINCT test_submission) AS distinct_tests_count
FROM
  biomarker_fda_test
GROUP BY
  test_manufacturer
fda_test_manufacturer_summary.description: Aggregated counts of FDA test rows by exact test_manufacturer. Useful for counting distinct tests per manufacturer and quick ranking of manufacturers by number of tests.

fda_test_with_fda_metadata.name: fda_test_with_fda_metadata
fda_test_with_fda_metadata.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.test_trade_name,
  t.test_submission,
  t.test_manufacturer,
  t.biomarker_origin,
  bfd.biomarker_drug,
  bfn.ncit_biomarker
FROM
  fda_tests_row_level AS t
  LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda AS bf
    ON bf.test_trade_name = t.test_trade_name
    AND bf.test_submission = t.test_submission
  LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda_drug AS bfd
    ON bfd.biomarker_fda_id = bf.id
  LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda_ncit_term AS bfn
    ON bfn.biomarker_fda_id = bf.id
fda_test_with_fda_metadata.description: Denormalized FDA test rows joined to biomarker_fda and related FDA-drug and FDA-ncit term tables when available. One row per FDA test (trade name + submission) with optional linked FDA metadata for richer filters.

species_rows.name: species_rows
species_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.speciescommonname AS speciescommonname,
  s.speciesid AS speciesid
FROM
  species s
species_rows.description: One-row-per-species table rows, exposing key and descriptive columns for species-level filtering and projection.

species_by_genus.name: species_by_genus
species_by_genus.body_sql:
SELECT
  genus,
  COUNT(*) AS species_count,
  -- lift literal: pick one example common name per genus (first by alphabetical order)
  (ARRAY_REMOVE(ARRAY_AGG(speciescommonname ORDER BY speciescommonname NULLS LAST), NULL))[1] AS example_speciescommonname
FROM
  species
GROUP BY
  genus
species_by_genus.description: Species grouped/cohorted by genus, exposing counts and examples; one row per genus to support genus-level summaries.

gene_to_ensembl_species_mapping.name: gene_to_ensembl_species_mapping
gene_to_ensembl_species_mapping.body_sql:
SELECT
  x.ensembl_gene_id,
  x.gene_symbol,
  s.speciesid,
  s.speciescommonname
FROM
  xref_gene_ensembl x
LEFT JOIN
  species s
ON
  x.speciesid = s.speciesid
gene_to_ensembl_species_mapping.description: Mapping of gene symbols to Ensembl gene ids with species information (links xref_gene_ensembl to species via speciesid) to support cross-table lookups involving species.

species_basic.name: species_basic
species_basic.body_sql:
SELECT
  species.speciesid AS speciesid,
  species.genus AS genus,
  species.species AS species,
  species.speciescommonname AS speciescommonname
FROM
  species
species_basic.description: Normalized projection of the species table exposing canonical identifier and name fields for downstream queries and joins.
validated_on: Show me all information about species

gene_to_species_mapping.name: gene_to_species_mapping
gene_to_species_mapping.body_sql:
SELECT
  x.ensembl_gene_id,
  x.gene_symbol,
  x.speciesid,
  s.genus,
  s.species,
  s.speciescommonname
FROM xref_gene_ensembl x
LEFT JOIN species s
  ON x.speciesid = s.speciesid
gene_to_species_mapping.description: Mapping of genes (by gene symbol and Ensembl gene id) to the species they belong to, joining xref_gene_ensembl to species by speciesid. Useful for questions that need gene lists with species metadata.

healthy_expression_by_species_anatomy.name: healthy_expression_by_species_anatomy
healthy_expression_by_species_anatomy.body_sql:
SELECT
  h.ensembl_gene_id,
  h.uberon_anatomical_id,
  h.uberon_developmental_id,
  h.expression_level_gene_relative,
  h.expression_level_anatomical_relative,
  h.call_quality,
  h.expression_rank_score,
  h.expression_score,
  x.speciesid,
  s.genus,
  s.species,
  s.speciescommonname
FROM
  healthy_expression AS h
LEFT JOIN
  xref_gene_ensembl AS x
  ON h.ensembl_gene_id = x.ensembl_gene_id
LEFT JOIN
  species AS s
  ON x.speciesid = s.speciesid
healthy_expression_by_species_anatomy.description: Healthy expression measurements joined to anatomical ontology and species via gene xrefs where available. One row per Ensembl gene / uberon anatomical / developmental id combination; includes expression level measures and the species id when mapped.

disease_mutation_row_level_12.name: disease_mutation_row_level_12
disease_mutation_row_level_12.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.id,
  dm.chromosome_id,
  dm.chromosome_pos,
  dm.ref_nt,
  dm.alt_nt,
  dm.ensembl_transcript_id,
  dm.cds_pos,
  dm.peptide_pos,
  dm.aa_pos_uniprotkb,
  dm.ref_aa,
  dm.alt_aa,
  dm.mutation_freq,
  dm.data_source,
  dm.doid
FROM
  disease_mutation dm
disease_mutation_row_level_12.description: One row per disease mutation, exposing the raw mutation attributes as stored. Useful as the base row-level cohort for counts, filters, joins, or projections about individual mutations.
validated_on: Show all information about disease mutations
counter_examples: List all disease mutation chromosome positions data for disease skin cancer

disease_mutation_with_tissue.name: disease_mutation_with_tissue
disease_mutation_with_tissue.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.id,
  dm.chromosome_id,
  dm.chromosome_pos,
  dm.ref_nt,
  dm.alt_nt,
  dm.ensembl_transcript_id,
  dm.cds_pos,
  dm.peptide_pos,
  dm.aa_pos_uniprotkb,
  dm.ref_aa,
  dm.alt_aa,
  dm.mutation_freq,
  dm.data_source,
  dm.doid,
  dmt.uberon_anatomical_id
FROM disease_mutation AS dm
LEFT JOIN disease_mutation_tissue AS dmt
  ON dm.id = dmt.disease_mutation_id
disease_mutation_with_tissue.description: Denormalized view joining disease_mutation to its annotated tissue (uberon id) when present. One row per disease_mutation.id with optional tissue Uberon identifier to support tissue-based filtering or grouping.

disease_mutation_with_articles_and_predi.name: disease_mutation_with_articles_and_predictions
disease_mutation_with_articles_and_predi.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.id,
  dm.chromosome_id,
  dm.chromosome_pos,
  dm.ref_nt,
  dm.alt_nt,
  dm.ensembl_transcript_id,
  dm.cds_pos,
  dm.peptide_pos,
  dm.aa_pos_uniprotkb,
  dm.ref_aa,
  dm.alt_aa,
  dm.mutation_freq,
  dm.data_source,
  dm.doid,
  COALESCE(a.article_count, 0) AS article_count,
  COALESCE(p.prediction_count, 0) AS prediction_count
FROM
  disease_mutation_row_level AS dm
LEFT JOIN (
  -- lifted literal: none
  SELECT
    dma.disease_mutation_id,
    COUNT(*) AS article_count
  FROM
    disease_mutation_article AS dma
  GROUP BY
    dma.disease_mutation_id
) AS a
  ON a.disease_mutation_id = dm.id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    dim.disease_mutation_id,
    COUNT(*) AS prediction_count
  FROM
    disease_mutation_impact_prediction AS dim
  GROUP BY
    dim.disease_mutation_id
) AS p
  ON p.disease_mutation_id = dm.id
disease_mutation_with_articles_and_predi.description: One row per disease_mutation.id with counts of linked articles and counts of impact predictions. Keeps row-level mutation fields plus two numeric measures (article_count, prediction_count) to support quick ranking or filtering by evidence volume. Measures are raw counts (not aggregated beyond per-mutation).

biomarker_core.name: biomarker_core
biomarker_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id AS id,
  b.biomarker_description AS biomarker_description,
  b.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  b.biomarker_id AS biomarker_id,
  b.test_is_a_panel AS test_is_a_panel
FROM biomarker b
biomarker_core.description: Normalized projection of the biomarker table exposing primary identifier, gene symbol, and descriptive fields. Useful as a base table for queries returning biomarker descriptions or joining biomarkers to aliases/articles/other metadata.
validated_on: Show me the gene symbol of biomarkers
counter_examples: Show biomarker gene symbol and description for 'breast cancer'
Show me the description of all biomarkers

biomarker_with_aliases.name: biomarker_with_aliases
biomarker_with_aliases.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id AS id,
  ba.alias AS alias,
  b.biomarker_description AS biomarker_description
FROM
  biomarker b
JOIN
  biomarker_alias ba
    ON ba.biomarker_internal_id = b.id
biomarker_with_aliases.description: Denormalized view joining biomarkers to their known aliases. One row per biomarker id + alias combination; good for searches by alias or returning canonical biomarker descriptions while matching on alternate names.

biomarker_with_articles.name: biomarker_with_articles
biomarker_with_articles.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.biomarker_description AS biomarker_description,
  b.id                                  AS biomarker_id,
  ba.pmid                               AS pmid
FROM biomarker b
JOIN biomarker_article ba
  ON b.id = ba.biomarker_internal_id
biomarker_with_articles.description: Denormalized view joining biomarkers to linked articles (pmid). One row per (biomarker.id, biomarker_article.pmid). Useful when filtering biomarkers by literature evidence or returning descriptions alongside article identifiers.

fda_test_trial_rows.name: fda_test_trial_rows
fda_test_trial_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.test_trade_name,
  t.test_submission,
  t.test_trial_id
FROM
  biomarker_fda_test_trial AS t
fda_test_trial_rows.description: Row-level cohort of FDA test trials (one row per FDA test trial row) from biomarker_fda_test_trial with the linking keys to the FDA test master record.

fda_test_master.name: fda_test_master
fda_test_master.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.test_trade_name AS test_trade_name,
  t.test_submission AS test_submission,
  t.test_manufacturer AS test_manufacturer,
  -- normalized manufacturer: uppercase, trimmed; lift literal transformations out of view by using functions only
  trim(upper(coalesce(t.test_manufacturer, ''))) AS test_manufacturer_normalized,
  t.test_number_genes AS test_number_genes,
  t.test_approval_status AS test_approval_status,
  t.test_manufacturer AS test_manufacturer,
  t.clinical_significance AS clinical_significance
FROM biomarker_fda_test t
fda_test_master.description: Canonicalized FDA test master records; one row per test_trade_name and test_submission with manufacturer and other metadata. Use to filter or join trial rows to manufacturer and attributes.

fda_test_trial_with_master.name: fda_test_trial_with_master
fda_test_trial_with_master.body_sql:
SELECT
  ttt.test_trade_name,
  ttt.test_submission,
  ttt.test_trial_id,
  ft.test_manufacturer,
  ft.test_number_genes,
  ft.test_approval_status
FROM
  biomarker_fda_test_trial AS ttt
LEFT JOIN
  biomarker_fda_test AS ft
ON
  ttt.test_trade_name = ft.test_trade_name
  AND ttt.test_submission = ft.test_submission
fda_test_trial_with_master.description: Denormalized rows joining FDA test trials to their master test record, producing one row per trial with manufacturer and test metadata.

biomarker_row.name: biomarker_row
biomarker_row.body_sql:
SELECT
  biomarker.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  biomarker.biomarker_description AS biomarker_description,
  biomarker.test_is_a_panel AS test_is_a_panel,
  biomarker.id AS id
FROM biomarker
biomarker_row.description: Base row-level view of biomarkers exposing identity, gene symbol, description, and panel flag. One row per biomarker record.
validated_on: Show the gene symbol and the description of cancer biomarkers which are not in a panel

biomarker_canonical_projection.name: biomarker_canonical_projection
biomarker_canonical_projection.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id AS id,
  -- canonicalized gene_symbol: trim whitespace; if empty string then set to NULL
  NULLIF(trim(b.gene_symbol), '') AS gene_symbol,
  -- canonicalized biomarker_description: trim whitespace; if empty string then set to NULL
  NULLIF(trim(b.biomarker_description), '') AS biomarker_description,
  -- preserve panel flag exactly
  b.test_is_a_panel AS test_is_a_panel
FROM biomarker b
biomarker_canonical_projection.description: Normalized projection of biomarker fields with canonicalized text (trimmed) and explicit null handling for gene symbol and description; preserves biomarker id and panel flag. Useful as a clean input for downstream joins and filters.
validated_on: Show the gene symbol and the description of cancer biomarkers which are not in a panel
counter_examples: Get the biomarker gene symbol and biomarker description for disease with name 'breast cancer'

biomarker_with_aliases_23.name: biomarker_with_aliases_23
biomarker_with_aliases_23.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id AS biomarker_internal_id,
  ba.alias AS alias,
  b.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  b.biomarker_description AS biomarker_description,
  b.test_is_a_panel AS test_is_a_panel
FROM biomarker b
JOIN biomarker_alias ba
  ON ba.biomarker_internal_id = b.id
WHERE 1 = 1
  -- liftable filter placeholder examples (do not hardcode values here):
  -- AND b.test_is_a_panel = false
  -- AND b.gene_symbol = 'TP53'
biomarker_with_aliases_23.description: Denormalized biomarker rows joined with their aliases (one row per biomarker alias). Useful when queries may filter or display alternative names/aliases for biomarkers.

disease_row.name: disease_row
disease_row.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.id,
  d.name
FROM
  disease AS d
disease_row.description: One row per disease exposing the disease primary key and name for filtering and projection. Useful as the base cohort for queries that select or count diseases by name or id.
validated_on: Return the symbol and p-value for the expression of EGFR in lung cancer
Show the pvalue of differential expression of lung cancer
counter_examples: Show disease mutation chromosome positions for skin cancer
List all disease mutation chromosome positions data for disease skin cancer

disease_name_normalized.name: disease_name_normalized
disease_name_normalized.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.id AS id,
  d.name AS name,
  lower(d.name) AS name_lower,
  regexp_replace(btrim(d.name), '\s+', ' ', 'g') AS name_trimmed
FROM
  disease d
disease_name_normalized.description: Canonicalized disease names and basic text-normalization columns to support case-insensitive or pattern searches and downstream text matching. Keeps one row per disease.
validated_on: Get the p-value of differential expressions for the disease 'lung cancer'
What are the name of cancer types where the A1BG gene expression is significantly increased (up regulated)
Return gen symbol and pvalue for the expression of gene with symbol 'EGFR' in lung cancer
Show name of diseases where the A1BG gene expression is statistically significant
Show name of diseases where the gene expression with symbol A1BG has a statistical significance of 'Yes'
counter_examples: Show biomarker gene symbol and description for 'breast cancer'

disease_with_related_mutation_counts.name: disease_with_related_mutation_counts
disease_with_related_mutation_counts.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.id,
  d.name,
  COUNT(dm.id) AS mutation_count
FROM
  disease d
LEFT JOIN
  disease_mutation dm
ON
  dm.doid = d.id
GROUP BY
  d.id,
  d.name
disease_with_related_mutation_counts.description: One row per disease with counts of related disease_mutation rows. Exposes disease id and name plus a raw mutation_count measure (no aggregation beyond counting per disease). Useful for filtering or ordering diseases by mutation burden.

biomarker_edrn_core.name: biomarker_edrn_core
biomarker_edrn_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  biomarker_title,
  qa_state,
  phase,
  id
FROM
  biomarker_edrn
biomarker_edrn_core.description: Normalized projection of biomarker_edrn with key columns and canonical textual fields. One row per biomarker_edrn.id exposing title, phase, and QA state for downstream filtering and joins.
validated_on: Show me biomarker titles and qa states for biomarker in phase Two
counter_examples: What are the different biomarker EDRN phases?

biomarker_basic_by_id.name: biomarker_basic_by_id
biomarker_basic_by_id.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id AS id,
  -- prefer biomarker_title from edrn when available, else NULL (lift literal 'biomarker_title' not used)
  be.biomarker_title AS biomarker_title,
  b.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  -- indicators: true if any alias rows exist for this biomarker.id
  (EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM biomarker_alias ba WHERE ba.biomarker_internal_id = b.id
  )) AS has_aliases,
  -- indicator: true if any article rows exist for this biomarker.id
  (EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM biomarker_article ba2 WHERE ba2.biomarker_internal_id = b.id
  )) AS has_articles
FROM biomarker b
LEFT JOIN biomarker_edrn be
  ON be.id = b.id
biomarker_basic_by_id.description: Denormalized minimal biomarker identity table keyed by biomarker.id linking primary biomarker table to alias and articles when needed. Exposes biomarker.id, biomarker_title (from edrn when available), gene_symbol (from biomarker), and indicators if aliases or articles exist. Useful for questions needing biomarker identity and cross-references.

biomarker_edrn_phase_counts.name: biomarker_edrn_phase_counts
biomarker_edrn_phase_counts.body_sql:
SELECT
  biomarker_edrn.phase AS phase,
  biomarker_edrn.qa_state AS qa_state,
  COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM
  biomarker_edrn
GROUP BY
  biomarker_edrn.phase,
  biomarker_edrn.qa_state
biomarker_edrn_phase_counts.description: Aggregate counts of biomarker_edrn records per phase and QA state. Useful for overview metrics and for answering counts or proportions by phase/state.

edrn_biomarker_core.name: edrn_biomarker_core
edrn_biomarker_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id AS id,
  b.biomarker_title AS biomarker_title,
  b.qa_state AS qa_state,
  -- carry through additional columns useful for filtering/joining (not required but keep joinable)
  b.biomarker_type AS biomarker_type,
  b.phase AS phase,
  b.uberon_anatomical_id AS uberon_anatomical_id
FROM
  biomarker_edrn b
edrn_biomarker_core.description: Row-level cohort of EDRN biomarkers (one row per biomarker_edrn.id) exposing title, QA state, type, phase, and anatomical mapping so callers can filter by phase or other attributes.

biomarker_edrn_with_anatomy.name: biomarker_edrn_with_anatomy
biomarker_edrn_with_anatomy.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id AS id,
  b.biomarker_title AS biomarker_title,
  b.qa_state AS qa_state,
  b.uberon_anatomical_id AS uberon_anatomical_id,
  a.name AS "anatomical_entity.name"
FROM
  biomarker_edrn b
LEFT JOIN
  anatomical_entity a
    ON b.uberon_anatomical_id = a.id
biomarker_edrn_with_anatomy.description: Denormalized EDRN biomarkers joined to anatomical entity names via uberon_anatomical_id to provide human-readable anatomical context for each biomarker_edrn row.

biomarker_rowlevel.name: biomarker_rowlevel
biomarker_rowlevel.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id AS id,
  b.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  b.biomarker_description AS biomarker_description,
  b.biomarker_id AS biomarker_id,
  b.test_is_a_panel AS test_is_a_panel
FROM biomarker b
biomarker_rowlevel.description: Row-level biomarker records from the biomarker table, exposing identifier and gene symbol for downstream filtering and aggregation.

biomarker_canonical_gene.name: biomarker_canonical_gene
biomarker_canonical_gene.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id AS id,
  b.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  -- Lifted literal: canonicalization = trim then upper-case
  upper(btrim(b.gene_symbol)) AS gene_symbol_canonical
FROM
  biomarker b
biomarker_canonical_gene.description: Normalized/cleaned gene_symbol values for biomarkers (trimmed and upper-cased canonical form) while preserving the biomarker id as the row key. Useful when queries need consistent gene identifiers or to deduplicate by normalized gene_symbol.

biomarker_gene_cohort.name: biomarker_gene_cohort
biomarker_gene_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  COUNT(b.id) AS biomarker_count
FROM
  biomarker b
GROUP BY
  b.gene_symbol
biomarker_gene_cohort.description: Aggregate view listing each gene_symbol observed among biomarkers with a count of biomarker records per gene. Grain is one row per gene_symbol (raw value). Keeps NULL-separated (can be filtered out in question_ops).

edrn_biomarker_row_level.name: edrn_biomarker_row_level
edrn_biomarker_row_level.body_sql:
SELECT
  be.id AS id,
  be.qa_state AS qa_state,
  be.biomarker_title AS biomarker_title,
  be.biomarker_type AS biomarker_type,
  be.uberon_anatomical_id AS uberon_anatomical_id,
  be.phase AS phase
FROM biomarker_edrn be
edrn_biomarker_row_level.description: Row-level cohort of EDRN biomarkers (one row per biomarker_edrn.id) exposing core metadata for filtering and projection.
validated_on: Show me the title of biomarkers on the EDRN platform with biomarker type different from Protein.
Show me the title of all biomarkers on the EDRN platform with biomarker type Protein in phase Two.
counter_examples: Show me all biomarkers on the EDRN platform with type protein in phase two.
Get all distinct biomarker EDRN phases

edrn_biomarker_canonical_type.name: edrn_biomarker_canonical_type
edrn_biomarker_canonical_type.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  NULLIF(NULLIF(trim(qa_state), ''), '')::character varying AS qa_state,
  NULLIF(NULLIF(trim(biomarker_title), ''), '')::character varying AS biomarker_title,
  NULLIF(NULLIF(trim(biomarker_type), ''), '')::character varying AS biomarker_type,
  NULLIF(NULLIF(trim(uberon_anatomical_id), ''), '')::character varying AS uberon_anatomical_id,
  NULLIF(NULLIF(trim(phase), ''), '')::character varying AS phase
FROM biomarker_edrn
edrn_biomarker_canonical_type.description: Normalized/cleaned projection of EDRN biomarker types and key metadata; canonicalizes empty strings to NULL and trims whitespace for consistent type filtering and joins.
validated_on: Show me the title of all biomarkers on the EDRN platform with biomarker type Protein in phase Two.
counter_examples: Show me all biomarkers on the EDRN platform with type protein in phase two.

biomarker_edrn_by_anatomical_site.name: biomarker_edrn_by_anatomical_site
biomarker_edrn_by_anatomical_site.body_sql:
SELECT
  uberon_anatomical_id,
  biomarker_type,
  COUNT(id) AS biomarker_count
FROM
  biomarker_edrn
WHERE
  -- lift question-specific literals out: include only rows with a non-null anatomical site
  uberon_anatomical_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  uberon_anatomical_id,
  biomarker_type
biomarker_edrn_by_anatomical_site.description: Counts of EDRN biomarkers grouped by uberon_anatomical_id and biomarker_type (one row per anatomical site and type). Useful for site/type cohort size and faceted filtering.

edrn_biomarker_type_canonical.name: edrn_biomarker_type_canonical
edrn_biomarker_type_canonical.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id AS id,
  b.biomarker_title AS biomarker_title,
  -- canonicalize biomarker_type: trim whitespace, lower-case, replace internal runs of whitespace with single space
  NULLIF(
    regexp_replace(
      lower(trim(b.biomarker_type)),
      '\s+', ' ', 'g'
    ),
    ''
  ) AS biomarker_type_canonical,
  -- has_title flag: true when biomarker_title is not null and not all whitespace
  (trim(b.biomarker_title) IS NOT NULL AND trim(b.biomarker_title) <> '') AS has_title
FROM biomarker_edrn b
edrn_biomarker_type_canonical.description: Normalized projection of EDRN biomarker rows with trimmed/canonicalized biomarker_type and non-null title flag to simplify type-based filtering and reuse.

edrn_biomarker_with_anatomy.name: edrn_biomarker_with_anatomy
edrn_biomarker_with_anatomy.body_sql:
SELECT

  a.description AS anatomical_description
FROM biomarker_edrn b
LEFT JOIN anatomical_entity a
  ON b.uberon_anatomical_id = a.id
edrn_biomarker_with_anatomy.description: Denormalized view joining EDRN biomarkers to anatomical_entity via uberon_anatomical_id to provide biomarker with anatomy name and description for filtering/grouping by anatomy.

biomarker_edrn_with_anatomy_43.name: biomarker_edrn_with_anatomy_43

biomarker_edrn_with_anatomy_43.description: Denormalized view of biomarker_edrn records joined to anatomical_entity to expose anatomical context (uberon -> name) alongside phase. Useful for questions that filter or group phases by anatomical site.

fda_test_rowlevel.name: fda_test_rowlevel
fda_test_rowlevel.body_sql:
SELECT

fda_test_rowlevel.description: Row-level cohort of FDA tests (one row per FDA test submission / trade name combination) exposing manufacturer, platform, study design and other test attributes for filtering and projection.

fda_test_manufacturer_projection.name: fda_test_manufacturer_projection
fda_test_manufacturer_projection.body_sql:
SELECT
  test_trade_name,
  test_submission,
  -- canonicalized manufacturer: lowercased, trim surrounding whitespace, collapse internal repeated spaces to single space,
  -- map common synonyms lifted out as parameters (replace examples below if needed)
  CASE
    WHEN test_manufacturer IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE
      -- normalize whitespace and case
      regexp_replace(trim(lower(test_manufacturer)), '\s+', ' ', 'g')
  END AS test_manufacturer,
  -- trimmed platform method and study design (lifted literals: none; just trimmed and collapse internal spaces)
  CASE
    WHEN platform_method IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE regexp_replace(trim(platform_method), '\s+', ' ', 'g')
  END AS platform_method,
  CASE
    WHEN test_study_design IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE regexp_replace(trim(test_study_design), '\s+', ' ', 'g')
  END AS test_study_design
FROM biomarker_fda_test
fda_test_manufacturer_projection.description: Normalized projection of FDA test metadata: canonicalized manufacturer name, trimmed platform_method and test_study_design text, and primary key columns. Useful for text-cleaning and downstream joins or filters by manufacturer.

differential_expression_with_disease.name: differential_expression_with_disease
differential_expression_with_disease.body_sql:
SELECT

  de.expression_change_direction AS expression_change_direction
FROM
  differential_expression de
LEFT JOIN

ON
  de.doid = d.id
differential_expression_with_disease.description: Denormalized join of differential_expression rows to their disease (via doid -> disease.id), exposing disease name alongside expression stats.

disease_mutation_with_disease_join.name: disease_mutation_with_disease_join
disease_mutation_with_disease_join.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.id AS id,

  dm.chromosome_pos AS chromosome_pos,

FROM disease_mutation_row_level dm
LEFT JOIN disease d
  ON dm.doid = d.id
disease_mutation_with_disease_join.description: Denormalized view joining disease_mutation to disease to provide mutation positional fields together with disease name. Useful for queries that need to filter or display mutations by disease labels.

disease_mutation_with_disease.name: disease_mutation_with_disease
disease_mutation_with_disease.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.id                                                   AS "disease_mutation.id",
  dm.chromosome_id                                        AS "disease_mutation.chromosome_id",
  dm.chromosome_pos                                       AS "disease_mutation.chromosome_pos",
  dm.ref_nt                                               AS "disease_mutation.ref_nt",
  dm.alt_nt                                               AS "disease_mutation.alt_nt",
  dm.ensembl_transcript_id                                AS "disease_mutation.ensembl_transcript_id",
  dm.cds_pos                                              AS "disease_mutation.cds_pos",
  dm.peptide_pos                                          AS "disease_mutation.peptide_pos",
  dm.aa_pos_uniprotkb                                     AS "disease_mutation.aa_pos_uniprotkb",
  dm.ref_aa                                               AS "disease_mutation.ref_aa",
  dm.alt_aa                                               AS "disease_mutation.alt_aa",
  dm.mutation_freq                                        AS "disease_mutation.mutation_freq",
  dm.data_source                                          AS "disease_mutation.data_source",
  d.id                                                    AS "disease.id",
  d.name                                                  AS "disease.name",
  dm.doid                                                 AS "disease_mutation.doid"
FROM
  disease_mutation dm
LEFT JOIN
  disease d
ON
  dm.doid = d.id
disease_mutation_with_disease.description: Denormalized view joining disease_mutation rows to their disease (id and name). One row per disease_mutation, with disease keys and labels to enable filtering by disease.name and returning disease metadata alongside mutation fields.

disease_mutation_with_articles.name: disease_mutation_with_articles
disease_mutation_with_articles.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.id AS id,
  dm.chromosome_id AS chromosome_id,
  dm.chromosome_pos AS chromosome_pos,
  dm.ref_nt AS ref_nt,
  dm.alt_nt AS alt_nt,
  dm.ensembl_transcript_id AS ensembl_transcript_id,
  dm.cds_pos AS cds_pos,
  dm.peptide_pos AS peptide_pos,
  dm.aa_pos_uniprotkb AS aa_pos_uniprotkb,
  dm.ref_aa AS ref_aa,
  dm.alt_aa AS alt_aa,
  dm.mutation_freq AS mutation_freq,
  dm.data_source AS data_source,
  dm.doid AS doid,
  dma.pmid AS pmid
FROM disease_mutation dm
JOIN disease_mutation_article dma
  ON dm.id = dma.disease_mutation_id
disease_mutation_with_articles.description: Denormalized view joining disease mutations to their associated article PMIDs. One row per disease_mutation × pmid pair to support literature-linked filters and counts.

disease_mutation_predicted_impacts.name: disease_mutation_predicted_impacts
disease_mutation_predicted_impacts.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.id,
  dm.chromosome_id,
  dm.chromosome_pos,
  dm.ref_nt,
  dm.alt_nt,
  dm.ensembl_transcript_id,
  dm.cds_pos,
  dm.peptide_pos,
  dm.aa_pos_uniprotkb,
  dm.ref_aa,
  dm.alt_aa,
  dm.mutation_freq,
  dm.data_source,
  dm.doid,
  imp.id AS "disease_mutation_impact_prediction.id",
  imp.site_prediction AS "disease_mutation_impact_prediction.site_prediction",

  imp.tool AS "disease_mutation_impact_prediction.tool"
FROM
  disease_mutation AS dm
JOIN
  disease_mutation_impact_prediction AS imp
ON
  imp.disease_mutation_id = dm.id
disease_mutation_predicted_impacts.description: Denormalized view joining disease mutations to their impact predictions and annotations. One row per prediction (impact) to support filtering by prediction tool, probability or feature annotations.

fda_tests_row_level_51.name: fda_tests_row_level_51

fda_tests_row_level_51.description: Row-level cohort of FDA tests from biomarker_fda_test, exposing each test's primary keys and key attributes for filtering and grouping.

fda_test_summary_by_manufacturer.name: fda_test_summary_by_manufacturer
fda_test_summary_by_manufacturer.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- grouping key: manufacturer name (lifted literal: NULL represents unknown manufacturer)
  COALESCE(test_manufacturer, 'UNKNOWN') AS test_manufacturer,
  -- count distinct tests by their canonical submission id (avoid double-counting same submission)
  COUNT(DISTINCT test_submission) AS num_tests
FROM
  fda_tests_row_level
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(test_manufacturer, 'UNKNOWN')
fda_test_summary_by_manufacturer.description: Aggregate counts of FDA tests grouped by manufacturer (one row per manufacturer) and optional summary measures.

differential_expression_rows_53.name: differential_expression_rows_53

SELECT

  d.statistical_significance AS statistical_significance,
  d.log2fc AS log2fc,
  d.pvalue AS pvalue,
  d.adjpvalue AS adjpvalue,
  d.subjects_up AS subjects_up,
  d.subjects_down AS subjects_down,
  d.subjects_total AS subjects_total
FROM differential_expression d
differential_expression_rows_53.description: Row-level cohort of differential expression annotations for genes in diseases (one row per gene-disease differential expression measurement). Does not apply question-specific literals; intended to be filtered by gene_symbol, expression direction, significance, or disease id.

gene_differential_expression_summary_by_.name: gene_differential_expression_summary_by_disease
gene_differential_expression_summary_by_.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  d.doid AS doid,
  COUNT(*) AS count_measurements,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.expression_change_direction = 'up' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_up,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.expression_change_direction = 'down' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_down,
  MAX(CASE WHEN d.statistical_significance = 'significant' AND d.expression_change_direction = 'up' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AS any_significant_up,
  AVG(d.log2fc) AS avg_log2fc
FROM
  differential_expression d
GROUP BY
  d.gene_symbol,
  d.doid
gene_differential_expression_summary_by_.description: Aggregated measures of differential expression for each gene in each disease: counts of measurements indicating 'up' vs 'down', and a flag if any measurement is statistically significant. One row per (gene_symbol, doid). Useful for filtering genes that are up-regulated in a disease based on multiple annotations.

differential_expression_with_disease_nam.name: differential_expression_with_disease_name
differential_expression_with_disease_nam.body_sql:

disease_mutation_with_disease_59.name: disease_mutation_with_disease_59
disease_mutation_with_disease_59.body_sql:
SELECT

  dm.aa_pos_uniprotkb AS aa_pos_uniprotkb,
  dm.ref_aa AS ref_aa,
  dm.alt_aa AS alt_aa,
  dm.mutation_freq AS mutation_freq,
  dm.data_source AS data_source,
  dm.doid AS doid,
  d.name AS "disease.name"
FROM

LEFT JOIN

ON

disease_mutation_with_disease_59.description: Denormalized view joining disease_mutation to the disease table to provide human-readable disease name alongside each mutation row. Keeps one row per disease_mutation.id.

disease_mutation_gene_transcript_map.name: disease_mutation_gene_transcript_map
disease_mutation_gene_transcript_map.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.id AS id,

LEFT JOIN
  map_uniprot_canonical_id muc
    ON mpdm.uniprotkb_ac = muc.uniprotkb_ac
disease_mutation_gene_transcript_map.description: Maps disease_mutation.enembl_transcript_id (note: ensembl_transcript_id column in disease_mutation) to protein/peptide identifiers via map_protein_disease_mutation and canonical Uniprot mapping. One row per disease_mutation.id to enable linking mutations to protein identifiers.

developmental_stage_lookup.name: developmental_stage_lookup

healthy_expression_with_stage.name: healthy_expression_with_stage

differential_expression_rows_63.name: differential_expression_rows_63
differential_expression_rows_63.body_sql:
SELECT

  de.adjpvalue,
  de.statistical_significance,

  de.subjects_nochange,
  de.subjects_nocoverage,
  de.subjects_total
FROM

differential_expression_rows_63.description: One row per differential expression measurement for a gene in a disease (study), exposing significance, effect sizes, and subject counts.

gene_to_disease_significant_expression.name: gene_to_disease_significant_expression
gene_to_disease_significant_expression.body_sql:
SELECT
  dlog.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  d.id AS disease_id,
  d.name AS disease_name,
  dlog.log2fc AS log2fc,
  dlog.pvalue AS pvalue,
  dlog.adjpvalue AS adjpvalue,
  dlog.statistical_significance AS statistical_significance,
  dlog.expression_change_direction AS expression_change_direction,
  dlog.subjects_total AS subjects_total
FROM
  differential_expression dlog
JOIN
  disease d
  ON dlog.doid = d.id
WHERE
  -- Lifted literals: statistical significance filter and optional adjp threshold
  dlog.statistical_significance = 'significant'
  AND (dlog.adjpvalue IS NULL OR dlog.adjpvalue <= 0.05)

semantic_filters.statistical_significance: IS NOT NULL and not in common negative markers

gene_to_disease_significant_expression.description: Denormalized rows linking a gene symbol to diseases where it has a statistically significant differential expression measurement, with core metrics; one row per (gene_symbol, disease.id).

gene_disease_expression_join.name: gene_disease_expression_join

biomarker_aliases_flat.name: biomarker_aliases_flat

biomarker_with_articles_67.name: biomarker_with_articles_67
biomarker_with_articles_67.body_sql:

biomarker_with_articles_67.description: Biomarker rows joined with associated article PMIDs (one row per biomarker–article pair) to allow filtering or enrichment by literature references.

biomarker_with_fda_tests.name: biomarker_with_fda_tests
biomarker_with_fda_tests.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id AS id,
  b.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,

    ON bf.id = b.id
LEFT JOIN
  biomarker_fda_test ft
    ON ft.test_trade_name = bf.test_trade_name
    AND ft.test_submission = bf.test_submission
biomarker_with_fda_tests.description: Denormalized view joining biomarkers to FDA test metadata when available; one row per biomarker-test combination (may be multiple tests per biomarker). Keeps biomarker identity plus FDA test fields for filtering or enrichment.

fda_test_use_rows.name: fda_test_use_rows

FROM
  biomarker_fda_test_use
fda_test_use_rows.description: Row-level cohort of FDA test usage records (each row = one reported use instance for a test).

fda_test_with_use.name: fda_test_with_use
fda_test_with_use.body_sql:

ON

biomarker_with_aliases_71.name: biomarker_with_aliases_71

biomarker_with_aliases_71.description: Denormalized rows linking biomarkers to their aliases. One row per biomarker alias; preserves biomarker id and alias text for searches and mapping aliases back to canonical biomarker rows.

biomarker_to_articles.name: biomarker_to_articles

SELECT

FROM

biomarker_to_articles.description: Mapping of biomarkers to literature (PMID). One row per biomarker-pub association; useful for filtering biomarkers by evidence presence or joining to external publication metadata.

biomarker_with_anatomy.name: biomarker_with_anatomy
biomarker_with_anatomy.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id AS id,
  b.biomarker_title AS biomarker_title,
  b.biomarker_type AS biomarker_type,
  b.phase AS phase,
  b.uberon_anatomical_id AS uberon_anatomical_id,
  a.name AS "anatomical_entity.name",
  a.description AS "anatomical_entity.description",
  b.qa_state AS qa_state
FROM biomarker_edrn b
LEFT JOIN anatomical_entity a
  ON b.uberon_anatomical_id = a.id
biomarker_with_anatomy.description: Denormalized biomarker rows joined to anatomical entity name/description when an uberon_anatomical_id is present. One row per biomarker_edrn.id; provides human-readable anatomy context for filters and results.

biomarker_edrn_with_anatomy_74.name: biomarker_edrn_with_anatomy_74
biomarker_edrn_with_anatomy_74.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id AS id,
  b.biomarker_title AS biomarker_title,
  b.biomarker_type AS biomarker_type,
  b.phase AS phase,
  b.uberon_anatomical_id AS uberon_anatomical_id,
  a.name AS "anatomical_entity.name"
FROM
  biomarker_edrn b
LEFT JOIN
  anatomical_entity a
    ON b.uberon_anatomical_id = a.id
biomarker_edrn_with_anatomy_74.description: Denormalized biomarker EDRN rows joined to anatomical_entity by uberon_anatomical_id to provide human-readable anatomical name alongside biomarker metadata. One row per biomarker_edrn.id (biomarker primary key). Useful when questions filter or display anatomical context.

biomarker_to_doid_via_edrn_tissue.name: biomarker_to_doid_via_edrn_tissue
biomarker_to_doid_via_edrn_tissue.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id AS biomarker_id,
  bedrn.id AS biomarker_internal_id,
  ct.doid AS doid
FROM
  biomarker b
JOIN
  biomarker_edrn bedrn
    ON bedrn.id = b.id
JOIN
  cancer_tissue ct
    ON ct.uberon_anatomical_id = bedrn.uberon_anatomical_id
JOIN
  disease d
    ON d.id = ct.doid
biomarker_to_doid_via_edrn_tissue.description: Denormalized mapping of biomarkers to disease ontology IDs (doid) by joining biomarker -> biomarker_edrn (via id) -> cancer_tissue (via uberon_anatomical_id) -> disease (via doid). Each row represents one link between a biomarker (biomarker.id) and a disease doid reachable through the EDRN uberon/cancer_tissue path.

biomarker_aliases_and_pmids.name: biomarker_aliases_and_pmids
biomarker_aliases_and_pmids.body_sql:
SELECT
  ba.biomarker_internal_id,
  ba.alias,
  ba_p.pmid
FROM biomarker_alias AS ba
JOIN biomarker_article AS ba_p
  ON ba.biomarker_internal_id = ba_p.biomarker_internal_id
biomarker_aliases_and_pmids.description: Associates biomarker.id with known aliases and linked article PMIDs. One row per biomarker.id x alias x pmid. Useful for matching external disease mentions or literature linking when resolving biomarker↔disease relationships from text or literature.

edrn_phase_canonical.name: edrn_phase_canonical
edrn_phase_canonical.body_sql:
SELECT
  be.id AS id,
  -- canonicalize phase: trim whitespace, map empty string to NULL, normalize common variations to a small controlled set
  CASE
    WHEN phase_trimmed IS NULL OR phase_trimmed = '' THEN NULL
    WHEN lower(phase_trimmed) IN ('phase i', 'phase 1', 'phase-1', 'i') THEN 'Phase I'
    WHEN lower(phase_trimmed) IN ('phase ii', 'phase 2', 'phase-2', 'ii') THEN 'Phase II'
    WHEN lower(phase_trimmed) IN ('phase iii', 'phase 3', 'phase-3', 'iii') THEN 'Phase III'
    WHEN lower(phase_trimmed) IN ('phase iv', 'phase 4', 'phase-4', 'iv') THEN 'Phase IV'
    WHEN lower(phase_trimmed) ~ 'phase\\s*v?i{1,3}\\b' THEN
      -- catch malformed roman numerals like 'phase v' but default to original trimmed with Title Case
      initcap(phase_trimmed)
    ELSE
      -- For other values, return trimmed value with first-letter capitalization for readability
      initcap(phase_trimmed)
  END AS phase_canonical
FROM (
  SELECT
    id,
    NULLIF(trim(coalesce(phase, '')), '') AS phase_trimmed
  FROM biomarker_edrn
) be
edrn_phase_canonical.description: Canonicalized/cleaned projection of biomarker_edrn.phase (trimmed, null-normalized) per biomarker_edrn.id to support consistent phase values across queries

biomarker_edrn_phase_counts_78.name: biomarker_edrn_phase_counts_78
biomarker_edrn_phase_counts_78.body_sql:
SELECT
  biomarker_edrn.phase AS phase,
  COUNT(*) AS biomarker_count
FROM
  biomarker_edrn
GROUP BY
  biomarker_edrn.phase
ORDER BY
  biomarker_edrn.phase
biomarker_edrn_phase_counts_78.description: Counts of biomarker_edrn records grouped by phase (useful for summaries and filtering by phase prevalence)

disease_differential_expression_join.name: disease_differential_expression_join
disease_differential_expression_join.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.id AS disease_id,
  d.name AS disease_name,
  de.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  de.pvalue AS pvalue,
  de.log2fc AS log2fc,
  de.adjpvalue AS adjpvalue
FROM
  disease d
JOIN
  differential_expression de
    ON d.id = de.doid
disease_differential_expression_join.description: Denormalized link of diseases to their differential expression rows to simplify queries that start from disease name and need expression p-values.
